findings.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect CVE-2026-0257 — Authentication-Override Cookie Forgery Actively Exploited, KEV-Added with 3-Day Federal Deadline
findings.affected_technology: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS + Prisma Access GlobalProtect portal/gateway (authentication-override-cookie feature enabled)
findings.summary: Attackers forge GlobalProtect authentication-override cookies to bypass authentication and obtain internal VPN IP assignment; Rapid7 MDR confirmed two same-operator exploitation waves (2026-05-17 + 2026-05-21) and CISA added the bug to KEV 2026-05-29 with a 3-day federal deadline.

findings.title: Flowise CVE-2026-40933 — Pre-Import Code Execution via Malicious Chatflow + MCP Tool (CVSS 9.9, Public PoC)
findings.affected_technology: FlowiseAI Flowise self-hosted (< 3.1.0); Flowise Cloud not affected
findings.summary: Malicious chatflow JSON with a Custom MCP Tool executes attacker commands during the auto-triggered canvas-enumeration step on import (no operator approval); Obsidian Security published a one-click PoC 2026-05-30, fixed in Flowise 3.1.0.

findings.title: CIFSwitch — 19-Year-Old Linux Kernel LPE to Root via CIFS Auth-Key-Description Forge + NSS Module Hijack (Public PoC)
findings.affected_technology: Linux kernel via cifs-utils — Mint 21.3/22.3, CentOS Stream 9, Rocky 9, AlmaLinux 9, Kali 2021.4-2026.1, SLES 15 SP7 confirmed; Ubuntu/Debian/Pop!_OS/openSUSE/Oracle/Amazon Linux potentially affected
findings.summary: Unprivileged local user forges a CIFS auth key description that loads an attacker-controlled NSS module via namespace switching, yielding root; 19-year-old bug fixed via upstream commit 3da1fdf with public PoC on GitHub, disclosed by SpaceX engineer Asim Viladi Oglu Manizada 2026-05-30.

findings.title: sshfs ≤ 3.7.5 — CVE-2026-47187 Symlink Escape (CVSS 9.3) + CVE-2026-48711 SSH Argument Injection (CVSS 7.0)
findings.affected_technology: sshfs FUSE SFTP filesystem client (CVE-2026-47187 ≤ 3.7.5; CVE-2026-48711 1.4 → 3.7.5)
findings.summary: Malicious SFTP server symlink targets containing '..' bypass sshfs containment to read/write arbitrary local files via cp, and companion mount-source argument-injection (e.g. [-oProxyCommand=CMD]:/path) yields command execution without SSH auth — both fixed in sshfs 3.7.6 (2026-05-29).
